problem: BB-007 runtime storage code is merged, but P0 cannot close until exact-source HTML5 CI executes and retains the real browser persistence lifecycle proof required by BB-P009.

decision.rationale: Reuse the already pinned Playwright/Chromium and exact-source development/release bundles in HTML5 CI, execute the BB-007 storage smoke against the same server, and retain a dedicated storage artifact without granting candidate code trusted governance authority.

governance.trust_boundary_change: The candidate modifies only the read-only pull_request/push HTML5 evidence workflow. It does not modify the trusted pull_request_target policy workflow, branch rules, permissions, secrets, bypass actors or merge authority.
governance.bypass_analysis: No bypass is introduced. Candidate code still cannot mutate repository state or redefine the trusted evidence-policy authority; merge remains gated by validate-pr-evidence from the base-controlled pull_request_target workflow.
governance.rollback: Revert the single HTML5 workflow commit that invokes/uploads storage_html5_smoke.py. Runtime BB-007 storage code and the existing trusted governance workflow remain independently intact.

research.candidate_pool_exception: This process change executes an already-implemented and validated BB-P009 test contract; no new player-facing design choice is made.
research.reference_exception: No shipped-game comparison is relevant to CI wiring for a previously selected storage protocol.

anti_pattern.observation: Treating sys.save return as proof of browser persistence would miss the HTML5 virtual-filesystem to IndexedDB lifecycle window.
anti_pattern.lesson: Exercise persistence across navigation and browser process restart and retain the machine-readable result.

official_docs.verified_constraint: HTML5 file persistence is browser-backed and may complete after the immediate write call, so browser lifecycle testing is required.
Defold HTML5 save files use the virtual filesystem backed by IndexedDB and sys.load may fail on corrupt data.

alternatives.reason: Uses the same exact-source bundles, server, pinned browser tooling and read-only candidate execution already trusted for P0 browser evidence.
Would duplicate browser/toolchain setup and create a second evidence path without improving isolation.
Cannot prove actual Defold HTML5 IndexedDB persistence across reload or browser process restart.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact-source HTML5 CI executes the BB-007 Playwright storage smoke against development and release bundles.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/defold-runtime-evidence.yml invokes tools/visual_qa/storage_html5_smoke.py after exact-source bundles are served.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Storage proof is retained independently from visual QA and generic HTML5 diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Workflow uploads storage-qa-<sha> from artifacts/storage-qa/<sha> with if-no-files-found=error.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trusted pull_request_target governance remains separate from candidate browser execution.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Only the read-only pull_request/push HTML5 workflow is modified; trusted PR evidence workflow is unchanged.

automated: Exact-head HTML5 CI must complete successfully with storage-report.json before merge.
Exact-head PR evidence trusted and repository standards checks must pass before merge.
Post-merge main HTML5 CI must repeat the storage proof.
verification.runtime_errors: The storage smoke fails on page errors, error-level browser console messages, missing/failed storage bridge results, lifecycle persistence failures or release test-bridge exposure.
verification.save_data_impact: No save format/runtime behavior changes in this process PR; it executes the merged BB-007 format and recovery implementation.

known_limitations: Poki/private-incognito and storage-unavailable portal behavior remain the explicitly later P0_P8 cases in BB-P009 and are not required by p0_exit_requirements.
Cloud save/cross-device behavior is not inferred from direct-web IndexedDB persistence.
